title: OSIRIS × CyberContext v0.3.0: Real SciFact Backend, Multi-Corpus BEIR Evaluation, and EXP-OLMO3 Evidence Capsule
description:
v0.3.0 integrates the Real SciFact Backend, the sealed EXP-OLMO3-BEIR-SCIFACT-001 benchmark evidence capsule, and multi-corpus evaluation across SciFact, NFCorpus, and CQADupStack.

OSIRIS × CyberContext is a zero-dependency, local-first companion runtime for autonomous coding agents, dense retrieval benchmarking, and low-latency physical device abstraction.

Key Architecture & Guarantees:

  • Real SciFact Backend & BEIR Evaluation: Replaces mock stubs with live, end-to-end evaluation against real SciFact abstract retrieval and claims verification datasets, recording MRR@10, NDCG@10, and CTC into append-only SQLite ledgers.
  • EXP-OLMO3 Evidence Capsule: Cryptographically verified benchmark evidence capsule (benchmark_capsule.evidence.zip) ensuring reproducibility and zero credential leakage.
  • CyberContext AST Provenance Firewall: L0/L1 deterministic static AST parser inspecting incoming session turns prior to SQLite memory compaction, neutralizing prompt injection and blocking dynamic execution primitives (exec, eval, os.system).
  • Tandemonium Hardware Mesh: Dual-substrate capability contracts (mobile edge vs compute workstation) enforcing strict execution horizons (300s / 1800s) and range-validated telemetry dispatching.

Source Code Repository: https://github.com/osiris-dnalang/osiris-cybercontext
